title: SharonAI Holdings Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-13
summary: SharonAI Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K on April 13, 2026, announcing its intent to commence a private offering of securities to eligible purchasers, subject to market and other conditions. The filing explicitly states it is not an offer to sell or solicitation to buy securities. This is a routine corporate disclosure under Item 8.01 (Other Events) with an attached press release as Exhibit 99.1.
key_points: SharonAI Holdings Inc. (ticker: SHAZ) is a Delaware corporation registered on Nasdaq with approximately 41.2 million shares outstanding
Filed 8-K Current Report on April 13, 2026, pursuant to Section 13 or 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934
Company announced intent to commence a private offering of securities to eligible purchasers
Filing explicitly disclaims any offer to sell or solicitation to buy securities
Signed by CEO James Manning on April 13, 2026
